title: Certifications, Marketplace and Training flow
env: Environment: dtp.ltsgroup.tech (web test) · Screenshots taken 05 Nov 2026 · Happy path only · Prepared by QA
intro: Test data: customer Development organisation, scope [QA] W3 C Cert C, certificate QA-D05-SMOKE-001 created for this document. Red boxes and labels were added for this document. Times in DTP are Taiwan time (UTC+8).
limitations: Sign-in: the test environment uses mock sign-in with a password. On the SGS environment users sign in with Microsoft Entra.
Email: on the test environment all mail goes to Mailpit, not real inboxes. Real delivery depends on the SGS SMTP set-up.
Training: on-site training is not in Phase 1 (TR-BUG-02 closed as won't fix); Training lists SGS Academy courses only.

steps.what: Add a certification for a customer scope.
steps.result: Certificate saved; the customer sees it at once.
body: Choose the customer, the scope and the standard, enter the certificate number and dates, and attach the certificate PDF (one PDF, up to 10 MB, scanned for malware).
shots: SGS Portal > Trust Centre: list of certificates issued by SGS Taiwan, Add certification button.
Add certification form filled in for QA-D05-SMOKE-001.

steps.what: Check the new certificate in the list.
steps.result: Certificate listed with status Valid and its validity dates.
body: The status is calculated from the Valid to date.
shots: Search by certificate number: the new certificate is listed as Valid.

steps.what: Open the certificate and download its file.
steps.result: Customer sees the certificate details (read only) and can download the PDF.
body: The Customer Portal Trust Centre is read only. The file can be downloaded after the malware scan marks it Clean.
shots: Customer Portal > Trust Centre: the certificate issued by SGS.
Certificate detail panel with the download button.

steps.what: Open the scope of the certificate.
steps.result: The Certifications card of the scope lists the certificate.
shots: Scope [QA] W3 C Cert C: the Certifications card shows QA-D05-SMOKE-001.

steps.what: Manage the consultant profiles shown in the Marketplace.
steps.result: Published profiles are visible to customers.
body: Marketplace content has two tabs: Pentesting services and Consultant profiles. Only Published profiles appear in the Customer Portal.
shots: Marketplace content > Consultant profiles: the published profile of Chen Wei.

steps.what: Browse consultants and open a consultant profile.
steps.result: Customer sees the profile: standards, services and languages.
shots: Customer Portal > Marketplace: Pentesting services and Consultants.
Consultant profile with the Start a request button.

steps.result: New Service Request opens with the consultant chosen.
body: From here the request continues as in the Service Requests flow document (Gap Analysis or Implementation Support).
shots: New Service Request, step 1 Request details, opened from the consultant profile.

steps.result: Course list with format and category filters; each course opens on SGS Academy.
shots: Customer Portal > Training: 20 courses, Open in SGS Academy links.

steps.where: SGS Portal > Audit logs; Customer Portal > Activity log
steps.what: Check that the certificate creation is logged.
steps.result: Event "Certificate added" appears in both logs.
body: SGS Admin sees events of every customer; the customer sees only events of its own organisation.
shots: SGS Portal > Audit logs: Certificate added · QA-D05-SMOKE-001 by Lin Mei.
Customer Portal > Activity log: the same event.

blocked: Sign-in on the SGS environment with Microsoft Entra.
The test environment uses a mock sign-in; Entra is set up only on the SGS DEV/UAT environment.
Each role can sign in to its portal through Entra.
On the test environment all mail goes to Mailpit; real delivery depends on the SGS SMTP set-up.
Emails arrive, links in them open the right page.
